name: Add Receipt Image Upload to Expense Tracker
objective: Add the ability to upload and associate receipt images with expense records using Supabase Storage.
facts: The expense tracker currently accepts amount, category, date, and description.
The new feature is to add receipt image upload capability.
Supabase is used as the backend and its file storage mechanism will be utilized.
Uploaded images will be stored in Supabase Storage.
Expense records will be updated with a reference to the uploaded receipt image.
The existing expenses table schema includes id (uuid), user_id (uuid), amount (decimal), category (text), description (text), date (date), created_at (timestamp).
The receipt image reference will be stored as an optional full URL string in the expense record.
File upload will be handled client-side in the expense form.
The Supabase Storage bucket to use is 'ale-images'.
The image upload is optional for the user.
Image preview will be shown in the expense form before submission.
Receipt image will be displayed only in the expense detail view, not in the list.
Users can replace or delete uploaded receipt images later.
Replacing or deleting images is allowed only in the expense detail view.
Deleting an image removes the file from Supabase Storage and clears the reference in the expense record.

summary: The session focuses on enhancing the expense tracker by enabling users to upload receipt images. This involves integrating file upload in the expense form, storing images in the existing 'ale-images' Supabase Storage bucket, and updating expense records with an optional full URL string referencing the receipt image. The expense table schema will be updated accordingly with example SQL code. File upload will be handled client-side and is optional for users. UI/UX details include showing image preview in the form, displaying images only in the detail view, and allowing users to replace or delete images only in the detail view. Deleting an image will also remove the file from Supabase Storage and clear the reference in the expense record. The plan includes essential code snippets for database migration, React component file input and preview, Supabase Storage upload and deletion, and expense record update. File structure suggestions include extending ExpenseForm.tsx and ExpenseDetail.tsx components and ensuring Supabase client configuration.
